Container.Name: NeedleDrop
Container.Overview: NeedleDrop is a vinyl-style client for Navidrome/OpenSubsonic. Browse your record collection, select exact Discogs pressings, use pressing-specific side/track layouts, and manually flip or change records in Vinyl Mode.
Container.Requires: A running Navidrome server reachable from this container. A Discogs personal access token is strongly recommended for exact pressing metadata. If /data is not writable, ensure /mnt/user/appdata/needledrop is writable by UID/GID 1001:1001.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the NeedleDrop WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent NeedleDrop data, including pressing choices and cached Discogs release metadata.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: URL NeedleDrop should use to reach Navidrome. Example: http://192.168.1.100:4533. Do not use localhost unless Navidrome is in the same container.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required 64-character random hex secret used to encrypt NeedleDrop sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Discogs Token
Config.Description: Discogs personal access token used for exact pressing selection, track/side layouts, release images, credits, notes and identifiers.

Config.Name: MusicBrainz User Agent
Config.Description: User-Agent sent to MusicBrainz and used to identify NeedleDrop API requests.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal directory used by NeedleDrop for persistent application data.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Use true only when NeedleDrop is accessed over HTTPS. Leave false for plain HTTP over LAN or Tailscale.
